label: Healthcare
tagline: Capacity, safety, and throughput intelligence for clinical operations.
narrative: Monitor ED wait times, bed occupancy, staffing strain, and safety signals. Detect anomalies early and recommend capacity and staffing interventions.

recommended_actions.title: Surge staffing
recommended_actions.detail: Trigger surge staffing protocol when strain index > 2σ sustained.

recommended_actions.title: Bed management action
recommended_actions.detail: Recommend transfers/discharge acceleration when occupancy spikes.

recommended_actions.title: Safety review
recommended_actions.detail: If incident rate spikes, initiate rapid safety huddle and root-cause capture.

alerts_catalog.description: ED wait time spike indicates throughput breakdown.
